name: @pipeworx/mcp-agify

tools.name: predict_age
tools.description: Estimate someone's age from their first name using global statistics. Returns predicted age and confidence count based on name frequency data.

name.description: First name to predict age for.

tools.name: predict_age_country
tools.description: Estimate someone's age from their first name within a specific country (e.g., 'US', 'FR', 'JP'). Returns predicted age and regional confidence count.

name.description: First name to predict age for.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE") to localize the prediction.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-agify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the agify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
